sar.narrative: Customer C12897, holder of card C12897-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-28 01:34 and 2016-11-28 01:44, 3 transaction(s) totalling $1,499.85 were made on the card online from device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.0.3 | mobile safari generic | 2208x1242': $499.93 (3493524, 2016-11-28 01:34), $499.96 (3493535, 2016-11-28 01:42), $499.96 (3493541, 2016-11-28 01:44). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. The activity is suspicious because: Case-memory model score 0.740; 3 online purchases within 10 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($499.93, $499.96, $499.96; total $1,499.85). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-4169, CC-4086, CC-3907. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.

stop_reason: Fraud probability 0.98 is at or above 0.85 with 3 independent pieces of evidence, so the decision is defensible without asking the customer (policy 6).
